observed: Emrusolmin preparation took 131 seconds; resolution took 95 seconds and reported four failed attempts at optional GSRS development-code enrichment.
reproduction: Offline public Gsrs.substances_named/codes_for seam, mocked network timeouts, simulated clock and an isolated database transaction. One name is sufficient: no article, model or live network dependency.

ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.hypothesis: Default retry count multiplies long request waits.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.prediction: One attempt substantially lowers outage duration.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.result: Default: 131 simulated seconds. One attempt: 31 seconds.

ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.hypothesis: Source pacing causes most of the delay.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.prediction: Removing only pacing eliminates most elapsed time.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.result: 127 simulated seconds without pacing, only four fewer; not the dominant cause.

ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.hypothesis: Enumerating intervention aliases causes the delay.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.prediction: A single name eliminates the delay.
ranked_hypotheses_and_probes.result: The failing minimal case uses one name; delay remains.

fix: Only GSRS defaults become two attempts and five-second network inactivity timeouts per phase. Shared source defaults remain four attempts and thirty seconds; existing explicit overrides remain supported.
limits: Not a whole-operation deadline. Network phases, Retry-After, shared pacing and separate successful requests can make total elapsed time longer. No global retry weakening, source-pacing change, alternative reader, model call, clinical scoring change or cache invalidation.

offline_verification.red: ReadTimeout and ConnectTimeout regressions failed before the fix: four attempts rather than two. Long Retry-After control already passed.
offline_verification.green: 138 affected source/resolve tests passed. Original offline loop fell from 131 to 13 simulated seconds; refusal remains explicit and no failure is cached. Later success is requested afresh and reused normally.
offline_verification.full_checks: make check passed: 1,565 pipeline, 660 site, 170 extension tests, lint and types. Strict OpenSpec validation passed.

candidate_live.reason: gsrs did not answer after 2 attempts.
candidate_live.method: One candidate GSRS lookup for the public intervention name in a rolled-back isolated test-database transaction; no prepare/model/clinical-registry work. This measures actual elapsed time, not a guaranteed whole-operation deadline.

release.verification: Merged source policy verified: GSRS defaults 2 attempts/5 seconds; Source and ClinicalTrials defaults 4/30. Offline loop passes at 13 simulated seconds. Released public snapshot exactly matches the prior 175-card build. No repeat prepare or paid call was required. Safari resources are unchanged.
